collector.registration: engine/src/state-sources.mjs and engine/src/precision-probes.mjs; bounded shared source runtime with official Utah DABS allowlisted sources

storeIdentity.proof: Utah DABS aggregate rows retain statewide/store-aggregate precision and never invent exact store IDs, addresses, or shelf quantities.

sourceSemantics.availability: Official allocated-release notices and board/warehouse aggregate context; not exact per-store shelf inventory.

stateFilter.assertion: Lifecycle-backed state controls include Utah after promotion.

areaFilter.reason: Current Utah precision is statewide/store aggregate, so no false city or store-area filter is exposed.

preferences.assertion: Preference validation derives supported states from active lifecycle configuration.

dashboard.assertion: Dashboard state selection derives from the active lifecycle and preserves the Utah caveat.

dropFeedApi.assertion: Utah rows are partitioned and filterable through the Drop Feed API while remaining informational and non-alertable.

finder.reason: Finder requires verified store/address identity; aggregate Utah rows do not fabricate that identity.

alerts.assertion: Both lifecycle and row semantics force Utah inventory and watch alert delivery off.

monitoring.assertion: State coverage, source runtime history, SLO artifacts, quarantine, and watchdog partition checks include Utah.

export.assertion: Canary and production exporters create a Utah state partition with official provenance and original timestamps.

shadow.artifact: engine/out/shadow/UT (three successful bounded runs on 2026-07-16; alerts disabled and production untouched)

canary.artifact: engine/out/canary/UT/site-run1 and site-run2 (two coherent canary builds with a Utah partition and zero Utah delivery alerts)

production.assertion: Promotion is non-deploying; guarded release and post-deploy smoke verification remain mandatory.
